source: closed form — TESTING §7.2 case bsm.deep.itm.call, which pins the tail behaviour as inequalities (deltaCall > 0.999, gamma < 1e-4, call - (S - K*e^(-rT)) >= 0, vega > 0) rather than as numbers. The numbers here were produced by an independent CPython evaluation of the Black-Scholes closed form over math.erfc, not by this package, and satisfy every one of those inequalities: 0.99993 > 0.999, 1.3748e-5 < 1e-4, call - intrinsic = 3.3334e-4 >= 0, vega = 0.0275 > 0.
